script:
Your parents died when you were young, and you've depended on your only sister, Wei Top Student, for survival. To support your sister's education, you gave up your own studies, worked various odd jobs, and finally found a job you really loved at Mango Daily - being a reporter.
You worked very hard and finally became the team leader of the gossip column in recent years.
Not long after becoming team leader, your sister suddenly told you one day that she didn't want to study anymore - she wanted to live for Yan Singer!
You've always doted on this sister. You roughly knew she was into celebrity worship before, but due to your busy work, you never properly understood your sister's situation. You didn't expect it had reached such an exaggerated extent.
Your sister had always been a model student, studying very seriously and applying for many scholarships. You were always proud of this.
Now your sister suddenly wanted to give up everything - of course you were unwilling. You tried to persuade her earnestly several times but to no avail.
You often thought this was all Yan Singer's fault for turning your sister into this state!
So you used your position to often follow and photograph Yan Singer, hoping to catch his scandals and expose them publicly, making your sister give up on him.
Unfortunately, Yan Singer had no gossip - he was always buried in music creation, so you were even more helpless about your sister's obsession.
In 2017, on a midnight in November, you and your assistant drove to the entrance of Yan Singer's new movie "Calling for You!" filming location, wanting to photograph Yan Singer's gossip, but never saw him come out. Just as you were about to fall asleep, your assistant woke you up. Looking closely, you saw Zhen Actress completely bundled up coming out from the side door, accompanied by a black-clothed man wearing a baseball cap - but that man wasn't Yan Singer. Searching your memory, you recalled that man was Zhen Actress's agent, Bai Agent!
The next second, they embraced and kissed! You instinctively grabbed your camera and took several shots - this was big gossip!
From what you knew, Zhen Actress became popular with her pure appearance and personality. Recently filming this movie, she had many rumors with Yan Singer, with everyone saying they were already together, and fans were shipping the real couple! You'd heard from colleagues that when Yan Singer was asked in interviews whether he was dating Zhen Actress, he didn't even deny it. Who would have thought Zhen Actress already had someone in her heart! And it was her own agent!
After returning home, you thought that since you couldn't catch Yan Singer's scandals, you'd tell him about this. If they really had a relationship, this would be quite a blow to him.
So you deliberately chose two days before the movie premiere to anonymously send the photo to Yan Singer. You also told Wei Top Student about this, hoping she would wake up from it.
Wei Top Student was very angry. You could see she was thinking of some crooked ideas. Fearing your sister might do something rash, you persuaded her that you would press this matter during the premiere day interview session, telling her not to act impulsively. Only then did your sister nod in agreement.
On April 19, the "Calling for You!" movie premiere began.
12:30 - You entered the venue as a Mango Daily reporter.
12:40 - Wei Top Student texted asking about Zhen Actress's interview time. You replied "14:30." Though curious why your sister asked this, you were too busy preparing to ask more.
14:30 - It was Mango Daily's turn to interview the movie creators. You were particularly aggressive with Zhen Actress today. Finally, seeing the interview time ending, you boldly asked: "May I ask if Teacher Zhen is still single as before? Or do you actually have an underground romance?" You saw Zhen Actress's face change, and Bai Agent quickly interrupted saying the interview time was over. You knew the truth of this matter couldn't be escaped.
16:10 - Host Hu announced the event's start. You sat in the media section preparing to film.
16:30 - The movie creators came out to speak. You felt Zhen Actress's complexion wasn't quite right, but didn't think much of it.
17:00 - The movie began screening. 5 minutes later, Zhen Actress was helped backstage by Bai Agent.
18:50 - The movie was almost over when you heard someone scream backstage. You grabbed your camera and rushed backstage, instinctively feeling there was news to capture. Unexpectedly, you saw Zhen Actress collapsed on the dressing room table, no longer breathing.
19:00 - Police arrived and sealed the scene.
acts_goal:
You are not the murderer, please clear your suspicions
You must actively reveal: Wei Top Student really likes Yan Singer
You cannot actively expose: You secretly photographed the deceased with Bai Agent and anonymously gave the photos to Yan Singer
